description: This PHP class 'ConsoleExceptionListener' handles console command events such as command start, termination, and errors within the Goteo application. It manages logging, locking, and error email notifications for CLI commands.

classes.name: ConsoleExceptionListener
classes.description: Handles console command events, logging, locking, and error notifications within the Goteo CLI environment.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of console events this listener subscribes to.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs messages using the command's logger if available, otherwise defaults to parent log method.

methods.name: onCommand
methods.description: Handles the start of a console command, sets up logging, locking, and command environment.

methods.name: addGlobalOptions
methods.description: Adds global options for email error reporting and process locking to the command.

methods.name: addGlobalOptionToSendErrorsByEmail
methods.description: Adds an option to send error logs via email.

methods.name: addGlobalOptionsToLockProcesses
methods.description: Adds options to lock the process to prevent concurrent execution.

methods.name: enableVerboseCommand
methods.description: Enables verbose logging if the verbose option is set.

methods.name: enableNiceColorsIfLoggerIsPresent
methods.description: Configures log formatting and email error handling if logger is available.

methods.name: onTerminate
methods.description: Handles cleanup after command execution, releases locks, and sends delayed emails.

methods.name: onException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during command execution, logs error details, and notifies via email if configured.
